chunks: Remember when Abraham said to Azar, his father: "Why do you take idols for God? I certainly find you and your people in error."
ai.seo_question: What did Abraham say to his father Azar regarding idol worship?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-An'am, this verse highlights Prophet Abraham's (AS) gentle yet firm dialogue with his father Azar, serving as a paradigm for da'wah that combines intellectual argumentation with familial affection. Shia scholars emphasize this narrative as a model for resolving religious differences through reason and patience, illustrating the transition from polytheism to pure monotheism (Tawhid).
